verdict.rationale: Logseq's docs describe a local HTTP APIs server, enabled in Features > HTTP APIs server, that gives external tools access to the graph "through authorization," so an agent can be given some kind of credential. Nothing in the evidence shows those credentials can be scoped, limited to certain pages or graphs, made read-only, or otherwise least-privilege. Missing for 10: per-token scopes or permission levels, read-only or graph/page-restricted credentials, multiple revocable agent-specific tokens, and independent hands-on corroboration.
